title: Beluga: A CXL-Based Memory Architecture for Scalable and Efficient LLM KVCache Management
authors: Xinjun Yang; Qingda Hu; Junru Li; Feifei Li; Yuqi Zhou; Yicong Zhu; Qiuru Lin; Jian Dai; Yang Kong; Jiayu Zhang; Guoqiang Xu; Qiang Liu

problem_statement.en: The limited capacity of GPU HBM necessitates offloading KVCache to host memory or remote pools, but existing RDMA-based disaggregated memory solutions suffer from high access latency, complex communication protocols, and significant synchronization overhead.
problem_statement.zh: GPU HBM 容量有限，迫使系統將 KV cache 卸載至主機記憶體或遠端記憶體池；然而現有基於 RDMA 的解耦記憶體方案存在存取延遲高、通訊協定複雜，以及同步開銷顯著等問題。

key_innovation.en: Beluga, a CXL 2.0-based memory architecture that enables GPUs and CPUs to access a shared, large-scale memory pool via CXL switches using native load/store semantics, eliminating the need for complex network stacks and bounce buffers.
key_innovation.zh: Beluga 是基於 CXL 2.0 的記憶體架構，允許 GPU 與 CPU 透過 CXL 交換器以原生 load/store 語義存取共享的大規模記憶體池，從而消除複雜網路協定棧與中繼緩衝區的需求。

key_improvements.en: 89.6% reduction in Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) and 7.35x throughput improvement in vLLM compared to RDMA-based solutions.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 RDMA 方案，TTFT 降低 89.6%，vLLM 吞吐量提升 7.35x。

ai_task: LLM Serving, LLM Inference, KVCache Management, RAG
compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H20, Intel Xeon Platinum 8575C, DDR5 4800 MT/s, CXL-based memory expander
network_hw: XConn XC50256 CXL 2.0 switch, ConnectX-7, PCIe 5.0 switches
